reviews.text:
Easy to use, accurate pedometer. There are ample set-up options and a clean, easy-to-use GUI that makes sense without needing a manual.

The configuration can be set up in a moment, changed later if need be, but most important is that my height and stride estimates yield accurate steps. No need to get bogged down with configuration but there for once-off use or if you wish to change.

This is my favourite app and I use it on a daily basis to track every step.

Great app with few tiny and rare ads in free mode, runs perfectly in free mode, with almost 0 distraction, plus there is the option to pay a cheap, yearly subscription. Given the utility of the app and importance of exercise, well worth the asking price, plus ability to cancel.
